assumption_visibility.rationale: Six explicit assumptions are documented covering development environment, target browser, player familiarity, hardware targets, communication requirements, and local filesystem access.

evidence_grounding.rationale: Three evidence references are provided linking to task metadata including initiative objectives, context specifying complexity XS and web-app type, and constraints around deployment and local execution requirements.

problem_clarity.rationale: The problem statement clearly articulates the objective to create a single-player space trading and combat game inspired by classic Elite, addressing the need for an engaging browser-based game combining economic mechanics with arcade combat.

risk_visibility.rationale: Four risks are clearly categorized (Technical and Adoption) with specific concerns about performance, AI balance, audience fit, and dependency management.

scope_boundedness.rationale: The candidate scope defines a minimum useful product with specific deliverables including Node.js server, canvas/WebGL rendering, star systems, commodity market, hyperspace mechanics, combat system, ship upgrades, save/load functionality, unit tests, and health endpoint.

stakeholder_coverage.rationale: Three key stakeholders are identified with clear roles: Player (end user), Developer (implementation and maintenance), and Quality Assurance (validation of tests and endpoints).

unknowns_manageability.rationale: Five specific unknowns are identified covering pricing algorithms, combat balance, visual effects, rendering optimization, and save/load mechanisms. These are technical implementation details that can be resolved during development.

non_blocking_gaps.description: Pricing algorithms for commodity market dynamics require specification during development
Combat balance parameters and enemy AI behavior need iterative tuning
Visual effects implementation details (particle systems, shaders) to be determined
Optimal canvas/WebGL rendering approach for target hardware requires performance testing
Save/load format and storage mechanism (localStorage vs files) needs architectural decision

payload.rationale: The proposal demonstrates comprehensive coverage across all seven readiness dimensions with clear problem articulation, well-defined scope, identified stakeholders, explicit assumptions, manageable unknowns, visible risks, and grounded evidence. The XS complexity rating is appropriate for the scoped web application. All dimensions are sufficient with no blocking gaps. The five non-blocking gaps are standard technical implementation details to be resolved during development.
